mapper.insert: INSERT INTO favorite ( user_id, book_id, create_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{bookId}, #{createTime} )
mapper.select:
SELECT b.id, b.isbn, b.book_name AS bookName, b.price, b.contact, b.condition_level AS conditionLevel, b.status, b.seller_id AS sellerId, b.create_time AS createTime
FROM favorite f JOIN book b ON f.book_id=b.id
WHERE f.user_id=#{userId}
ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
